Service Name
Xxx_CompareKey
Syntax

const uint8* Key,
Dcm_OpStatusType OpStatus,
Dcm_NegativeResponseCodeType* ErrorCode
)
Service ID [hex]
0x47
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Key

Parameters (in)
OpStatus
Status of the current operation
Parameters (inout)
None
